entities.summary: Tawakkol Karman (b. 1979-02-07, Ta'izz) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ta'izz and Yemen. Known in the fields of yemen, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
